messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — vendor asked for a KMS key binding so their cross-project SA can decrypt ciphertexts for the new partners namespace (partners/eu-1). Before we proceed I want to confirm RBAC & audit implications. Looping in @Selena and @Raj.
Selena: Quick q — is this a new key or do they want access to an existing keyring?
Raj: New key. They provided SA: partners-sa@gcp-partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com and want key in proj-partners-eu.
Alina: Cross-project SA + decrypt rights is risky if done at project level. Make it key-level binding only. Also enable CMEK audit logs for that project/key.
Morgan: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) create a dedicated key `partners-eu-key` (purpose=ENCRYPT_DECRYPT), 2) apply IAM binding limited to that cryptoKey, 3) update audit sink to include cloudaudit for the key's project, 4) canary apply in partners-staging. Anyone object?
Selena: Also need to think about Vault integration. If Vault transit is wrapping things with that KMS key, the Vault SA will need access too (or we use a Vault plugin). Confirm which Vault mount touches this key.
Raj: Right — two options: let Vault call KMS directly (give Vault SA access) or have partner SA call KMS themselves for partner-owned blobs. For our model I prefer we keep Vault as the single rewrap orchestrator and give Vault a short-lived SA that has only decrypt on this key.
Alina: Important: use key-level IAM and, if possible, add an IAM Condition to narrow member by `request.auth.claims` or serviceAccount name. If conditions not feasible, make sure we document the blast radius.
Morgan: For rollback/runbook we should include rewrap steps if key needs to be revoked. Example snippet for rewrap in Vault:```bash
# read old ciphertext, decrypt via KMS, re-encrypt with new key
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@old.ctxt rewrap_to_key=new-key
```
Selena: I'll grep our Vault mounts for references to `projects/proj-` patterns. Also add SOPS/backup checks — backups that used KMS must be identified.
Raj: Also schedule an initial rotation policy: create key, wait 30 days, then rotate automatically every 90 days thereafter. Confirm with partner SLA. Note: GCP doesn't support TTL on bindings so rotation is manual (or automated via infra job).
Morgan: I'll open infra PR with two commits: create key and add IAM binding for partner SA (key-level). I'll also include updating the logging sink and a smoke test that attempts a wrap/unwrap from the partner SA in staging. PR will be assigned to Alina + Selena for review.
oncall-bot: Deploy plan created: infra/pr/4321 by Morgan. CI: smoke tests queued. ETA 2h.
Alina: Please include explicit rollback commands in the PR description: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/.../cryptoKeys/partners-eu-key --member="serviceAccount:partners-sa@..."` and steps to rewrap any Vault-stored secrets.
Selena: Found two Vault paths referencing the prod key ring: `vault/kv/data/partners/config` and `vault/kv/data/partners/backup-meta`. Adding them to the checklist.
Raj: Small gotcha — if partner SA tries to decrypt an older wrapped blob created with old key version, rewrap required; we must ensure we have access to the old key version or re-encrypt customer data before removing access. Add that to runbook.
Morgan: Plan summary: Morgan creates PR, assign Alina+Selena, run canary in partners-staging (eu) for 24h, then promote to prod if no errors. Notify vendor before prod cutover. Schedule rotation ticket 30d post-creation. Ensure SIEM receives an alert for CryptoKeyAccess events for that SA.
Alina: Also document in RBAC playbook that partner SA is constrained to key-level bindings and no project roles are created. Add example `gcloud` command to the docs:```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/proj-partners-eu/locations/eu/keyRings/partners-keyring/cryptoKeys/partners-eu-key \
  --member="serviceAccount:partners-sa@gcp-partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```
Selena: I'll run the grep across repos for KMS references and post a list in the PR.
Raj: After deploy, double-check logging sink for `cloudaudit.googleapis.com/activity` entries and that Security can query BQ dataset.
oncall-bot: PR merged by Morgan. Deploy started. Smoke tests passed in staging.
Alina: Verified audit log entry present in staging: serviceAccount:partners-sa@... shows CryptoKeyAccess entries. No unexpected principals.
Morgan: Rolling to prod now and notifying vendor.
Selena: After prod is green I'll kick off the rotation ticket and add a reminder in the security calendar.
Raj: Post-deploy checklist item: confirm key versions, update vault metadata to reference current key version, and ensure old key versions are scheduled for destruction when safe.
Morgan: Thanks all — waiting for the two reviews before merge window. If there are no objections I plan to merge at 17:00 UTC. Tagging security-ops for retention: @security-ops
